summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Learning Day: Dress Your "Monster" in a Clown Costume ## Introduction Welcome to the Marvelous Designer Learning Day! In this session, we will explore the creative process of dressing your "monster" in a clown costume using the powerful tools of Marvelous Designer. ## Setting the Scene Back in all my things for the summer, lying on my bed, it's a bummer. Cause I didn't call when I got your number, but I liked you a lot. ## Emotions and Inspirations Slipping on my dress and soft filters, everybody said you're a killer. But I couldn't stop the way I was feeling the day your record dropped. ### The White Mustang The day I saw your white Mustang. Your white Mustang—caught up in my dreams and forgetting. I've been acting like I'm a kid because you held me in your arms just a little too tight. That's what I thought. ### Summer Love and Regret Summer's meant for loving and leaving. I was such a fool for believing that you could change all the ways you've been living, but you just couldn't stop. ### Revving Up Emotions The day I saw your white Mustang. Your white Mustang—revving it up. And the sun was bright now, and you were getting all bad about it. ## The Light of Connection And you're the only one in town. You could see the light. You can see the light. You're gonna hear me like lightning—white Mustang. ## Contemplating Life and Death Oh death, oh death, won't you spare me over another. But what is this that I can't see with eyes full of... When God is gone and the devil takes hold, who'll have mercy on your soul? ### The Nature of Death Oh death, no wealth, no ruin, no silver, no gold. Nothing satisfies me but your soul. Well, I am death; none can excel. I'll open the door to heaven or hell. ## Reflections on Relationships My name is Dad, and the enemy is here. Never really felt bad about it as we drank deep from the light. Cause I felt melting magnets, babe, the second I saw you through half-shut eyes. ### Dancing with Uncertainty Smoking sunset off Mulhall, I was wondering about you and that girl. She your girl? Girlfriend, face from heaven. Bet the world she doesn't know. Pretty girls don't know the things that I know. ## Embracing Freedom Uh-oh, dancing past the point of no return. Let's go; we can free ourselves of all we've learned. I love the secret language that we're speaking. Say it to me. ### The Point of No Return Let's embrace the point of no return. Never really thought we would make it. We'd be thinking about what could've been, but we've had a record. Summer can't turn it down. ## The Desire to Connect I want you to fall into this world, floating in the sky, singing the song I want to sing. Hurry and destroy me. ## The Rebel Spirit A couple of rebel top gun pilots flying with nowhere to be. Don't know you super well, but I think that you might be the same as me—behave abnormally. ### Embracing the Unconventional Let's let things come out of the woodwork. I'll give you my best, I'll tell you all my best lies. See me rollin', showing someone else love. ## The Night of Friends Dancing with our shoes off, no, I think you're awesome, right? Our rules, our dreams, we're blind—blown up with homemade dynamite. ## Nostalgia and Memories When I was born, I lived on Poplar Street. Just a little child with plans, just on my knees, watching home runs from up in the trees. ### The Complexity of Relationships I feel like a human. Graves, I was in my bed. Please drink to the crisp end. I am a true romantic, free-falling, I'm acting. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching. Let's keep exploring the creative possibilities together in Marvelous Designer. ```
